rows.speaker: CABINET
rows.text: ONE COIN. ONE COURSE. ONE MORE TRY.

rows.speaker: QUARTERMASTER
rows.text: YOU CLEARED MY SCREEN. NOW CLEAR YOUR DEBT.

rows.speaker: KRIS
rows.text: You return the coin. The machine remembers generosity.

rows.speaker: QUARTERMASTER
rows.text: NO DEBT REMAINS. KEEP THE CHANGE.
